assertions.text: Output is a valid YAML document
pipeline_id values are UUID-shaped placeholders (or explicitly flagged as needing the real Orchestra pipeline UUID from the pipeline URL) — never a literal Dagster job/asset name

The correct cross-job mechanism is chosen for the source semantics: trigger_events: for reactive/launch-only patterns (run_status_sensor, asset_sensor), a TRIGGER_PIPELINE task for explicit mid-flow launch-and-wait — not the other one used interchangeably
